patthana21.51:1.1: no saññojanaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nosaññojano sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. tīṇi pañhā. noganthagocchakaduka nasanidassanattike ganthagocchakaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.51:2.1: no ganthaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nogantho sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.51:3.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nooghagocchakaduka nasanidassanattike oghagocchakaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.51:4.1: no oghaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noogho sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.51:5.1: hetuyā tīṇi. noyogagocchakaduka nasanidassanattike yogagocchakaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.51:6.1: no yogaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noyogo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.

patthana21.51:9.1: hetuyā tīṇi. noparāmāsagocchakaduka nasanidassanattike parāmāsagocchakaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.51:10.1: no parāmāsaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noparāmāso sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.51:11.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasārammaṇaduka nasanidassanattike sārammaṇaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
